title: Curious Urgency 60
author: bpatrick
body: I better keep posting so Jonny Paycheck doesn’t go silent again.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.text:
At least this strip club doesn’t have any graffiti on the bathroom walls. Very classy.

I’ll be going on vacation in a couple days for two weeks. My time on the internet for the first week will be spotty at best, but I will be living in a tent in the Rockies for the second week. I’m wondering how many new comics you can make with all my free time.

comments.author: randomjackass
comments.text: For how happening that club seemed, it’s very quiet in that bathroom.

comments.author: randomjackass
comments.text: But the tension in the last two pages has been great.
